title: Sequence Browser computational pack (.czpack)
description: Manifest that brings a small ONNX sequence model into Sequence Browser as one or more inference tracks.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor validation.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest format version. Only 1 is supported.

id.description: Stable machine id for the pack, e.g. "seqbro2-puffin".

name.description: Human-readable pack name shown in the UI.

assemblyId.description: Assembly this model was trained for, e.g. "hg38". Used to prompt an assembly switch on import.

type.description: Only the UCSC sequence API is supported today.

genome.description: UCSC genome name passed to the sequence API, e.g. "hg38".

url.description: URL or path to the .onnx file, resolved relative to the pack URL.

inputName.description: Name of the sequence input. Defaults to the model's first input. The sequence is fed as a float32 tensor of shape [1, 4, L] (one-hot, channel order A,C,G,T; unknown bases are all-zero).

fixedInputs.description: Constant scalar inputs fed on every run as float32 tensors of shape [1] (e.g. a threshold).

inference.description: Optional runtime hints. Sensible defaults apply when omitted.

flankBp.description: Context bases the model consumes on EACH side without emitting output for them. Load-bearing: a wrong value shifts every coordinate. For a valid-convolution model, output length == input length - 2*flankBp.

maxWindowBp.description: Upper bound on the visible span the model may compute (declared ceiling). The browser further caps this to whatever fits its ~1s latency budget at the model's measured cost.

maxResolutionBp.description: Only compute when the view is at least this fine (bp per output bin). Prevents whole-chromosome inference.

transcriptPadding.description: For a transcript model trained on transcripts flanked by N: the browser feeds N for bases within `bp` of a same-strand canonical transcript's ends (outside it), matching how training windows looked. Needs a canonical transcript annotation for the assembly (MANE Select on hg38).

bp.description: N bases on each end of a transcript in training.

plotGroups.description: Optional multi-series display composition. Output groups remain independently selectable and are only coalesced at render time.

subtrackIds.description: Specific outputs included in display order.

groupIds.description: Whole output collections appended in display order.

comparesEdits.description: The plot an edited sequence is compared against: re-run on the modified sequence and shown beneath the modified row. One group per pack; with none declared, the first plot group is used.

subtracks.description: One rendered track per entry. Distinct subtracks may read different outputs or different channels of one output.

kind.description: "signal" draws a filled waveform; "annotation" draws interval/density features.

outputName.description: Model output to read. Its last dimension is the position axis; leading dims are treated as channels.

channelIndex.description: Which channel of a multi-channel output to plot. Defaults to 0.

transform.description: Applied per output value before binning. Defaults to identity.

groupId.description: Stable collection id for output visibility controls.

plotGroupId.description: Fallback multi-series plot id when no pack-level plotGroups entry matches.

lineStyle.description: Optional per-series curve style. Pack-level dashed group declarations take precedence.

defaultVisible.description: Whether this output is shown when the model is first added. Defaults to true.

role.description: Scientific role displayed in the track label.

scaleMode.description: Positive signals use a bottom baseline; signed signals use a centered zero baseline.

defaultSignalDisplay.description: Initial signal visualization. Sequence mode uses true one-value-per-base samples as signed A/C/G/T heights and falls back to a signal when zoomed out.

stableMarginBp.description: Minimum computed-output margin retained around the visible range when feasible, for outputs whose edge values depend on inference context.

fixedScale.description: Pin this output's y-axis to a known range (e.g. a probability is [0,1]). Omit for outputs whose scale is data-dependent; a signed contribution must omit it or its negative half is clipped.

renderStyle.description: 'bars' draws one mark per base, for outputs that are one value per base; 'line' (default) joins values for continuous signal.

scaleShapes.description: Y-axis shapes this output enables beyond the linear, power and log every signal offers. 'complement-log' draws -log10(1 - p), giving each nine (0.9, 0.99, 0.999...) the same height; it needs a probability, so the output must declare a fixedScale inside [0, 1].

mutagenesis.description: Derive this row by exact in silico saturation mutagenesis of outputName/channelIndex instead of reading it. For each base on screen the browser re-scores the window with that base substituted, three times; the value is the summed absolute change in probability within contextBp of the base, averaged over the three substitutions. Unsigned: a base the calls depend on and a base whose mutation would create a call both read high. Computed only while the view is at most maxSpanBp wide.

contextBp.description: Absolute changes within this many bases of the mutated base are summed. Defaults to 500.

maxSpanBp.description: Computed only while the view is at most this wide; the row says so when it is wider. Defaults to 400.
